Gulf Shores Main Public Beach (Gulf Place)
Gulf Shores Main Public Beach (Gulf Place)
Visit Website

Take a Virtual Tour

Contact

Address

101 Gulf Shores Pkwy.
Gulf Shores, AL 36542
Get Directions

Phone

(251) 968-2040
Previous
Next

If you are looking for volleyball-playing, beach-bar-hanging good times, this spot - where Highway 59 dead-ends into the Gulf - is for you. Seasonal Parking fees are required, via the convenient Park Mobile app. Restrooms and beach rinse showers on site. Life Guards, open-air pavilions, and a large grassy "Town Green" is available.

The City of Gulf Shores considers accessibility a high priority and provides four beach mats to make the beach more accessible. Three beach access mats are located at Gulf Place, and one beach access mat is located at East Gulf Place near the resident parking area. 

Before you break for the beach, familiarize yourself with our  beach flag warning system and review the rules and regulations for our public beaches. We also ask that you respect our shores and help protect our beloved natural resources during your visit.

DAILY BEACH REPORT: 

Friday, May 15, 2026
 		 	
Medium Hazard 
Moderate surf and/or currents
 

Today’s Flag Color: Yellow Flags. Yellow Flags represent Medium Hazard with Moderate Surf and Currents. Please swim with caution. 

Gulf Temperature: 75 degrees
Surf Conditions: Calm with waves at 1 or less and west running currents.
Rip Current Forecast: Low Risk
Daily Weather: Sunny with the high temperature is in the mid 80s.
Wind: Southeast winds at 5 to 10 mph.
UV Index: Very High. 
Tides: Low Tide is at 5:45 PM. High Tide is at 7:11 AM. 

 

*Please review the rules and regulations and respect our shores to help protect our beloved natural resources during your visit. Adhere to the white Leave Only Footprints flags and remove all belongings at the end of your day.    
LIFEGUARDS & BEACH PATROL AVAILABILITY

Please be advised that there will be no lifeguards on duty on Gulf Shores and Orange Beach public beaches from October through February. During this time, beach patrol and response will be limited. Always check the beach flags and surf conditions before entering the water, and never swim alone. Scroll to view an interactive map of lifeguard tower locations on Alabama's beaches.

Beach goers at Alabama Point East public access can borrow life jackets while enjoying their time on the beach. These life jackets are free and are available in various sizes. We encourage children and those who aren’t strong swimmers to take advantage of these vests. Remember to return them before you leave.

Gulf Shores & Orange Beach Weather

play_arrow
Get to Know the Beach Flag Warning System
BEACH FLAG WARNING SYSTEM

Beach warning flags are posted at all public beach areas in Gulf Shores, Orange Beach and Gulf State Park. Conditions are monitored throughout the day. Please remember that the absence of red flags does not assure safe conditions. Within the corporate city limits of Gulf Shores and Orange Beach, it is illegal to enter the Gulf when two red flags are displayed.

HOW TO SPOT A RIP CURRENT
Rip currents are most prevalent when the waves crash perpendicular to the beach rather than at an angle.
One of the easiest ways to spot a rip current is to look for gaps between the waves. A small patch of calm water surrounded by waves is often a rip current. 
Look for discolored water near the shore. Rip currents tend to drag large amounts of sand and sediment back out to sea with them, so many rip currents are easily identified by a noticeable flow of sand extending away from the shore.
Rip currents are also common in areas near sand bars, piers, pilings and jetties. 
play_arrow
Escape the Rip
Now

Rip currents are powerful, narrow channels of water moving quickly away from shore. They occur on all beaches and may happen at any time. Before you hit the beach, learn how to recognize a rip current and how to escape if caught in one.

HOW TO ESCAPE A RIP CURRENT
Remain calm. Fighting the rip current can exhaust you. 
Escape the current by swimming parallel to the shoreline. When free of the current, swim at an angle—away from the current—toward shore. 
If unable to escape by swimming, float, or tread water. When the current weakens, swim at an angle away from the current toward the shore.
If at any time you feel you will be unable to reach shore, draw attention to yourself: face the shore, call, or wave for help.
To help someone else caught in a rip current, first call 9-1-1 for assistance, then seek help from a lifeguard. If a lifeguard is not present, yell instructions on how to escape or throw the victim something that floats.

Why Book With Us
Book Your Lodging With Us

If you’re looking for an unforgettable beach getaway, our shores are the place to be. When planning your vacation, our website has everything you need to seamlessly craft your trip, even lodging. You’ll discover trusted accommodations across Alabama’s Beaches in Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan. Our direct booking experience saves time and removes stress thanks to verified listings, secure payments, and real support. When you book on our site, you can rest easy knowing you are working with local, trusted professionals.

Your Trusted Source for Stays on Alabama’s Beaches

Our booking platform provides travelers with a dependable choice for securing lodging. We’re committed to helping people find the perfect stay for their beach vacation with a positive booking experience. That’s why the listings we provide are from vetted individuals and businesses with whom we’ve formed long-standing relationships and who are committed to providing quality stays. There’s no guessing when it comes to the listings on our site, as each one is accurately represented.

Enjoy Peace of Mind When You Book With Us

Unlike other reservation platforms, our site is geared to offer guests a convenient way to book lodging. From searching to staying, we provide travelers with a seamless experience. When you book with us, you’re not just booking a place to stay. You’re choosing a platform that prioritizes your needs, safety, and peace of mind with every step.

Perks of Booking Direct With Alabama's Beaches
1
Reserve in Minutes

Imagine having the perfect beachfront condo or spacious vacation home booked and confirmed in five minutes. This can be a reality when you book with us. The simplicity of our booking process allows guests to go from searching to confirmation in just a few clicks. No account creation or complicated steps are required.

2
Locals Who Know Best

The listings on our site are powered by people who live and work along Alabama’s Beaches. Unlike national booking sites, you’ll receive support from local experts, including genuine recommendations and direct communication with the hosts. These listings are curated with firsthand knowledge of the area, so you can trust that the descriptions are accurate.

3
Verified Stays You Can Trust

Every property on our booking platform is carefully reviewed for accuracy, and each host is vetted. The information on the listings is consistent with the actual property, including the images, so you don’t have to worry about misleading photos. You can expect complete transparency from the owners about their listing.

4
Support You Won’t Get Elsewhere

Guests who book with us can communicate directly with the property owner or host. You can reach out with questions, special requests, or concerns before, during, or after booking. Unlike faceless platforms, real support is always available from people who know the destination.

All nonstop flights are three hours or less and land at Gulf Shores International Airport (GUF), just three miles from the beach. There's so much you can do with all the time you'll save!

Book Today, Beach Tomorrow

Relax on Alabama's Gulf Coast Beach Houses with Pools, Decks, and More

Find the beach house that feels just like home, but with a view you’ll never forget. The beach house rentals in Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan offer spacious interiors, fully-equipped kitchens, and private outdoor spaces for you to enjoy every moment by the coast.


Many beach homes come with private or community pools, picnic tables for family gatherings, porch swings to soak up Gulf sunsets, and even fish cleaning stations for your day’s catch. Imagine the convenience of a boat-friendly rental with a dock or pier, perfect for a day on the water. 


For those looking for a little friendly competition, some properties even feature tennis courts, shuffleboards, putting greens, or fitness centers. These beach houses are not only designed for comfort but are also steps away from the area’s best experiences, whether it’s a rental close to a golf course or a house near The Wharf.


Dive into your dream beach escape and find the ideal beach rental for your stay, or explore other vacation homes in Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan for more coastal lodging options.
 

 

Why a Beach House on Alabama’s Beaches Is the Perfect Choice for Your Stay

 Beach houses in Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan bring the coast to life with distinct styles, thoughtful details, and oceanfront views. Whether you’re dreaming of a peaceful retreat, a family-friendly adventure, or a touch of luxury, these beach rentals are crafted to match your vacation vision. Dive into the options and find the beach house that speaks to you.

Location

Ensure you are choosing the right rental property for your perfect vacation style. Want to be close to your favorite attractions? Or, do you prefer the calmer vacation found down West Beach Boulevard? If this is your first time visiting Alabama's Beaches, here is a helpful blog to aid in your decision of staying in Gulf Shores or Orange Beach. 

Gulf Access

Many of our beach house rentals in Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan offer Gulf Access. Choose the view you desire, Gulf-front or one of our other beachfront properties. If you choose to stay on a property that does not offer direct beach access, here is some helpful information to help you easily access our Alabama Gulf Coast Beaches. For daily beach safety updates, visit our Beach Safety page to help you and your loved ones have a fun, safe vacation. 

Pet - Friendly Properties

Are you bringing your furry friend along for the trip? Here on the Alabama Gulf Coast, we welcome all members of your family. More than 40 beach houses on Alabama's Beaches are considered pet-friendly rentals. Check out some of our pet-friendly properties to accommodate your furry friend. 

Parking

Sometimes parking can be tricky- determine if your selected property covers parking or if you will need to find additional parking. If they cannot provide a parking location, there are several overflow parking options for a small fee, ensuring you’ll have easy access to your beach house vacation rental.

Luxury Accommodations

In a beach house rental, you may find multiple televisions, a stereo system, a washer/dryer, a grill, board games, extra blankets and towels. In the kitchen, you will find many appliances you need for meal prep—from blenders to frying pans, cutting boards, and toasters. Some have private pools, boardwalks giving direct access to the Gulf, grassy yards, and spacious porches. With so many conveniences on-site, you’ll find packing to be a breeze. Need some help with a packing list? Here are some useful packing tips from our vacation experts. 

Quiet and Spacious

Vacationing in a beach home is notably peaceful, as you are engulfed in a relaxing atmosphere where you can sleep in or watch the sunset just as easily. Beach house rentals offer more space for you and your family to enjoy breathtaking views while in a calming environment. 

Options For All Party Sizes

Whether you need a simple two-bedroom home near a public beach access, a Gulf-front rental that sleeps more than 30, or something in between, Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan rental homes come in many different locations and sizes. You can be picky about your décor as well, so you can rent the beach home that best fits your timeline and taste in this one-of-a-kind destination.

Amenities

Before settling on your beach house rental- research the different amenities that will be included to fit the needs of you and the rest of your party. Some beach house rentals offer in-home fitness rooms, gaming rooms, multiple kitchens, and spacious parking areas. Check with your desired rental company to discover the amenities they have to offer. 

Why Book
With Us

Our direct booking experience saves time and removes stress thanks to verified listings, secure payments, and real support. When you book on our site, you can rest easy knowing you are working with local, trusted professionals.

Book Now

Exclusive Vacation Deals for Your Alabama's Beaches Vacation 

Your next beach adventure is closer than you think with exclusive offers on Alabama’s Beaches. With discounts on stays, seasonal deals, and family-friendly packages, these specials make it easy to say yes to a spontaneous getaway or a planned retreat. Whether it’s Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, or Fort Morgan calling your name, these special offers help you enjoy every moment in your beach home rental at an exceptional value. 

Book Your Beach House and Let Alabama’s Beaches Work Its Magic 

Imagine coffee with a view, the sound of waves as your morning soundtrack, and a cozy spot to watch the sunset right from your porch. When you stay in Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, or Fort Morgan beach rentals, each day brings easy moments like these, inviting you to relax and truly take in the coastal vibe. Ready to make it real? Book your stay today, settle in, and let Alabama’s Beaches welcome you home.

Top Reasons to Book a Condo in Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, & Fort Morgan

Condo rentals offer a flexible way to experience Alabama’s Beaches. With room to spread out, a kitchen to call your own, and all the comforts you’d expect from a great vacation stay, a beach condo feels like more than just a place to sleep. You’ll enjoy the space and privacy to start each day on your terms, whether you’re sipping coffee on the balcony of your condo, floating in the lazy river, or flying down the waterslide. Here are some key features and tips to consider when looking for the perfect condo in Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan.

Location

Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan condos offer easy access to Alabama Gulf Coast white-sand beaches while being conveniently located to annual festivals and events, local golf courses, and local attractions like The Wharf.

Amenities

When deciding on a condo rental in Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, or Fort Morgan, check out the array of amenities offered by beach condos to find the perfect one for you and your crew. Many condos in Orange Beach and Gulf Shores boast lazy rivers, waterslides, and indoor or heated pools. Some kid-friendly condos also offer amenities such as game rooms, pickleball courts, outdoor games, and scheduled activities. Don’t worry, there’s lots of fun for the adults too, as many beach condos in the area are perfect for a couple’s stay. At an Alabama's Beaches condominium, most units include a balcony with a partial or complete view of the Gulf. 

Kitchens

While the restaurants in Alabama's Beaches boast delicious fresh seafood pulled straight from the Gulf, the convenience of a private kitchen and eating area in a condo unit cannot be overstated.  There’s something special about taking at least one day to stay out on the sand as the sun starts to dip then prepare and enjoy a leisurely dinner alfresco on your patio table. 

Unique Décor

Because many condominiums are privately owned, the décor will vary, even within the same complex. This means you can find a unique space that puts you in the vacation mood you prefer. Whether you want florals, neutrals, a beach theme or something modern, you can narrow your requirements by number of bedrooms, desired amenities, and location. Then, browse the available units to find the perfect décor for your Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, or Fort Morgan vacation rental.

Pet-Friendly Condos

Bring the whole family along—paws included! Alabama’s Beaches welcomes pets with open arms, and our pet-friendly rentals make it easier than ever to share the beach with your four-legged friend. No more boarding or guilt; instead, your pet can join in on every sandy adventure, sunset stroll, and cozy evening by your side.

Spacious Rooms

Condos on Alabama's Beaches vary in size. No matter your party size, we have the condo to fit your needs. Choose from multiple bedrooms and bathrooms, or for a smaller family, choose a one-bedroom condominium. 

Beach Chairs

Most beachfront condos offer on-site beach rentals like chairs and umbrellas just outside your door for a resort-style experience. Some property owners even include beach gear with your stay. This added convenience lets you skip the hassle of bringing your own gear, so you can fully relax and soak up the sun. Those looking to hit the water in style can take advantage of the beach condos that offer excursions and watersport rentals that guests can book on-site.

Private Balconies

From gulf-front condo rentals to those set just steps from the sand, many condominiums offer private balconies where you can relax with views of the Gulf. Imagine starting your day with coffee as the sun rises over the water or unwinding in the evening as the sun sets—all from your own private space. A balcony gives you your own quiet space to take in the coast’s beauty, whether it’s a peaceful morning or a vibrant sunset scene.

Find Your Perfect Stay on Alabama's Beaches

Alabama's Beaches have around thirty unique hotels in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach, making your trip planning easy and stress-free. With so many lodging options, you will find a hotel perfect for your stay, whether traveling for a romantic beach getaway, a family vacation, or a solo retreat.


Some visitors spend their days exploring nature trails, relaxing on the beach, or enjoying water activities, only needing a hotel room to recharge between activities. Others will spend more time at their hotel, enjoying amenities such as pools, beach views, on-site dining, and fitness centers. No matter your hotel needs, it's easy to find something that works for you on Alabama's Gulf Coast.

Types of Hotels in Gulf Shores & Orange Beach 

Imagine a hotel stay that blends the stunning scenery of Alabama's Gulf Coast with everything you care about most. From sunrise views on your balcony and afternoons splashing at the pool to stress-free, pet-friendly stays or convenient amenities for business travel, Orange Beach and Gulf Shores hotels feel less like just a place to stay, and more like the beach getaway you've always dreamed about. 

Beachfront Hotels

Wake up steps from sugar-white sand beaches and sparkling turquoise waters. Many hotels on Alabama's Beaches are located directly on the beach, offering convenient Gulf access. Choose the view you desire, Gulf front or one of our other waterfront properties. Even if your hotel isn't directly beachfront, you'll find convenient ways to reach our beaches quickly. For daily beach safety updates, visit our Beach Safety page to help you and your loved ones have a fun, safe vacation. 

Family-Friendly Stays with Pools

Need a break from the sand? Most of the hotels in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach offer pools that will surely be a hit with the family. From Gulf-front pools and hot tubs to indoor and heated pools, a hotel pool is exactly what you need. It's the perfect way to cool off, unwind, and entertain everyone.

Pet-Friendly Hotels

Your furry friends deserve a vacation, too! Alabama's Gulf Coast warmly welcomes pets with accommodations that make traveling with animals stress-free and enjoyable. Check out some of our pet-friendly properties when deciding where to book your stay. 

Hotels with On-Site Dining & Kitchen

Whether you prefer to cook at home or sit back and let someone do it for you, Alabama's Beaches hotels can fit your needs. From full-size kitchens and complimentary breakfast to on-site restaurants, Gulf Shores and Orange Beach hotels offer exactly what your family is looking for.

Business & Meeting-Friendly Hotels

If you are coming to Gulf Shores and Orange Beach for business, our hotels have got you covered. With spacious meeting rooms and adaptable business centers, an Alabama Gulf Coast hotel has the means to fit your company's individual needs. Visit our meetings page for more information about bringing your meeting to Gulf Shores and Orange Beach.

Beach Rentals

You can leave the beach umbrellas and chairs at home, as several Gulf Shores and Orange Beach hotels offer on-site beach rentals. These beachfront hotels will set up beach chairs and umbrellas along the shoreline for you, taking away the stress of hauling your gear down to the water each day.

Cabins offer guests the chance to disconnect from the world around them and reconnect with nature without giving up the comfort and convenience of a relaxing vacation. You’ll be surrounded by a diverse array of local plant life and wildlife while enjoying the various amenities provided by your rental.

Fly Nonstop to Alabama's Beaches

Driving to Alabama's Beaches is so last year. Our destination now offers nonstop flights to and from several major US cities through Allegiant Airlines. All nonstop flights are three hours or less and land at Gulf Shores International Airport (GUF), just three miles from the beach. There's so much you can do with all the time you'll save!

View Non-Stop Flights

Amenities Galore

You’ll find everything you need and more when you rent a cabin in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach. Outdoor seating areas, spacious bathrooms and incredible views are just a few of the amenities offered at the cabin rentals in the area. Many rentals also allow pets, so you can bring your furry friends along with you on your beach vacation.

Get Outdoors

Exploring the spellbinding environment of Alabama’s beaches is a breeze when staying in a cabin. Grab a bike and ride around the miles of trails in the area or go for a satisfying run on the beach. You’ll soon discover that the opportunities to get lost in nature are endless, thanks to the abundance of outdoor activities and watersports.

A Winter Escape

The Alabama Gulf Coast boasts comfortable temperatures year-round, which makes it the perfect place to avoid the harsh weather that winter brings up north. You can still enjoy activities like fishing and golfing in the cooler months. Cozy up in a coastal cabin on Alabama’s beaches for an unforgettable winter escape.

Pet-Friendly Vacations
Pet-Friendly Lodging for the Perfect Family Vacation

Vacations are more meaningful when the whole family comes along, including your pets. We make it easy to find the right place to stay with pet-friendly rentals across Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan that cater to both human and four-legged guests. Just select your preferred type, dates, and number of guests to begin! With local property managers who prioritize your comfort and peace of mind, you can book with confidence, knowing everyone—including your furry friends—will have a great stay. Start planning your pet-friendly getaway today! BOOK NOW!

Explore Rentals on Alabama's Beaches

Whatever your vacation style, Alabama’s Beaches have the perfect spot for you. Start planning by choosing your dates and group size, and explore the best vacation rentals in Gulf Shores, comfortable places to stay in Orange Beach, or the charming rentals of Fort Morgan. With verified listings, secure payments, and real support, there are plenty of reasons why you should book with us.

Whether you’re dreaming of a beachfront escape in Gulf Shores, a charming retreat in Orange Beach, or a peaceful hideaway in Fort Morgan, you’ll find options designed to keep your pets comfortable and happy. Why Book
With Us

Our direct booking experience saves time and removes stress thanks to verified listings, secure payments, and real support. When you book on our site, you can rest easy knowing you are working with local, trusted professionals.

Book Now

Fly Nonstop to Alabama's Beaches

Driving to Alabama's Beaches is so last year. Our destination now offers nonstop flights to and from several major US cities through Allegiant Airlines. All nonstop flights are three hours or less and land at Gulf Shores International Airport (GUF), just three miles from the beach. There's so much you can do with all the time you'll save!

View Non-Stop Flights

Pet-Friendly Vacations in Gulf Shores, Orange Beach & Fort Morgan

Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan offer a wide variety of pet-friendly lodging choices, from hotels and vacation rentals to beach houses and condos, all ready to accommodate dogs and cats with a small deposit. If you prefer camping or an RV park, pets are generally welcome without deposit requirements. Just remember to follow the rules, keep your pet leashed, and enjoy the great outdoors with your trusted companion. Be sure to review your lodging destination's pet policy, so you’re fully prepared and ready for your vacation! With so many rental options, you’re sure to find the perfect place for you and your pet.  

Pet-Friendly Vacation Homes

For a stay with space to spread out, our pet-friendly homes in Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan offer a comfortable setting where everyone, including your pets, can feel at ease. Browse a variety of vacation rentals with spacious yards and welcoming interiors that let you settle in and make the most of your time together.

Pet-Friendly Condos

Pet-friendly condos provide a cozy, convenient place to call home during your stay. With many condo rentals close to the beach and local spots, you’ll find a space that’s well-suited for you and your pet to enjoy a relaxed getaway.

Pet-Friendly Hotels

Our selection of pet-friendly hotels makes it easy to settle in, offering a range of amenities and locations that welcome pets alongside their families. Find a hotel that places you near Alabama’s Beaches’ dining, shopping, and activities for a stay that’s simple and comfortable.

RVs & Campgrounds

If you’re drawn to the outdoors, RV parks and campgrounds in the area provide the ideal setting. With open spaces and scenic spots, these campgrounds make it easy to enjoy the Alabama Gulf Coast’s natural beauty with your pet by your side.

Pet-Friendly Long-Term Rentals

Travelers with pets will feel right at home in our long-term vacation rentals across Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan. With mild weather, nearby trails, and plenty of space, you and your pet can settle in and enjoy Alabama’s Gulf Coast together all season long. 

Coastal Code
#106

Beach days are better when shared.

Pet-Friendly Vacations

 

Tips for Choosing a Pet-Friendly Rental For Your Stay 
Determine the most appropriate type of lodging for your pet's size and temperament. You can choose from hotels, condos, campsites, and beach house rentals! Book directly on our website today.
Make a lodging reservation, communicating your needs regarding your pet. This way, there are no surprises when you arrive.
Select a room appropriate for the pet, just as you would for family members with special needs.
Check the room before letting your pet run free to ensure there are no hazards or tempting chew objects.
Check out our pet-friendly lodging to find the perfect place for your whole family.
Pet-Friendly Attractions on Alabama’s Beaches 

There are plenty of pet-friendly activities for you and your pet to enjoy across Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan.

Pet-Friendly Marinas

For boaters with pets, many pet-friendly marinas in the area welcome furry friends aboard—just be sure to check in with the marina for any pet guidelines. And when you come ashore, keep your pet leashed and be mindful of other boaters.

Dog Parks

Let your pet run and play at one of the area’s dog parks, where they can meet other dogs and enjoy some open space. These parks are conveniently located near vacation rentals and beaches, making it easy to pop by for a little exercise and socializing.

Scenic Trails for Pet-Friendly Walks

Enjoy a peaceful walk with your pet along the Gulf Coast’s scenic trails, like the Hugh S. Branyon Backcountry Trail or Wade Ward Nature Park. These beautiful paths are perfect for a leisurely stroll, offering shaded spots, open views, and plenty of fresh air for you and your furry companion.

Local Spots That Welcome Pets

In addition to trails and dog parks, Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan offer plenty of pet-friendly spots to explore together. Relax at outdoor cafes and restaurants or visit popular local parks that welcome pets. With so many pet-friendly places, you and your pet will have plenty to explore and enjoy, making every day along Alabama’s coast a new adventure.

Exclusive Vacation Deals & Offers You’ll Love 

Find special deals tailored for every type of traveler, from families and couples to groups of friends, snowbirds, and those traveling with pets. Our exclusive offers in Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan include savings on vacation rentals, family packages, and long-stay seasonal discounts, so you can enjoy more of what matters—time together. Browse the latest special offers to book a memorable, pet-friendly stay along Alabama’s coast, where beautiful beaches, warm hospitality, and countless adventures await. 

Book Your Pet-Friendly Stay on Alabama’s Gulf Coast 

The natural beauty of Alabama’s Beaches is meant to be shared with loved ones—especially pets! Enjoy the wide-open spaces, pet-friendly accommodations, stunning beach views, and pet-friendly attractions that make Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan a one-of-a-kind escape. Book your place to stay today and start planning a pet-friendly vacation that brings you all even closer together.

Owner-Managed Vacation Rentals
Find Your Perfect Stay

From spacious beach houses to waterfront condos and cozy cottages, you’ll discover an array of magnificent places to stay on our shores. When you stay in an owner-managed accommodation, you book directly with the owner. This allows you to form a one-on-one connection with the owner, who can answer any questions you may have about the rental. These properties are also ideal for short stays as they typically don’t have a required length of stay like many other property types. All the listings on our site are owned and operated by licensed rental owners.

With Us

Our direct booking experience saves time and removes stress thanks to verified listings, secure payments, and real support. When you book on our site, you can rest easy knowing you are working with local, trusted professionals.

Fly Nonstop to Alabama's Beaches

Driving to Alabama's Beaches is so last year. Our destination now offers nonstop flights to and from several major US cities through Allegiant Airlines. All nonstop flights are three hours or less and land at Gulf Shores International Airport (GUF), just three miles from the beach. There's so much you can do with all the time you'll save!

View Non-Stop Flights

There are two B&B inns in the Gulf Shores and Orange Beach area and they are textbook examples of everything that makes these accommodations such a special place to stay for a Gulf vacation.

Romar House

In Orange Beach, the Original Romar House Bed & Breakfast Inn is set on the Alabama Gulf with private access to the beach, sparkling beach-view pools, hot tub, swing and hammock, and an outdoor patio with sweeping views.
Amenities also include:

Full breakfast
Complimentary wine and cheese social hour (daily, except Sunday)
Guest parlor with TV and magazines
Limited WiFi
Onsite spa services available
Magnolia Springs Bed & Breakfast

Just north of Gulf Shores, a vision of yesteryear lives on in Magnolia Springs, the only place in the U.S. where mail still arrives by boat via the Magnolia River. Within this hamlet of live oaks and gracious homes, the Magnolia Springs Bed & Breakfast – built as a private home in 1897 – offers beautifully decorated rooms and suites with private baths and a host of amenities to go with them:

Two-course breakfast
Refreshments
Turn-down service
WiFi
Wrap-around porch
A “great hall” with a fireplace where guests relax and mingle

When romance is on the agenda for a Gulf Shores or Orange Beach vacation, many travelers start searching for bed and breakfast inns. Often historic, picturesque and private, B&B's are known for their romantic ambiance and quaint charm. If you are planning your next beach getaway, the Alabama Gulf Coast is an unforgettable location, with charming bed and breakfast options for a more local and quaint lodging experience. In addition to the charm, bed & breakfast inns offer solid travel amenities, including:

Full breakfast vs. the quick continental breakfast offered by the standard hotel
Complimentary refreshments in the afternoon or evening
Distinctly furnished rooms reflecting local flavor and character, unlike the uniform look found in hotel chains
In-room baths are the norm, not the exception
Porches, gardens and secluded spots for those seeking private moments
Friendly, frequent presence of the innkeepers, who see to your needs personally and are on hand to help you plan activities or answer questions about the inn’s history

Fly Nonstop to Alabama's Beaches

Driving to Alabama's Beaches is so last year. Our destination now offers nonstop flights to and from several major US cities through Allegiant Airlines. All nonstop flights are three hours or less and land at Gulf Shores International Airport (GUF), just three miles from the beach. There's so much you can do with all the time you'll save!

Campgrounds & RV

Camping in Gulf Shores & Orange Beach is a great affordable way to experience our beaches and wildlife. When you visit and camp in the area, you’ll have numerous amenities available to you on top of the numerous attractions from our beaches to shopping to dining. 

Changing the current slide of this carousel will change the current slide of the preceding main image carousel.

An RVer's Paradise
Choose from Gulfside campgrounds or bayside parks within walking distance to our miles of white sand beaches. For easy access to fishing or beach activities, pick a location near a marina. Our inland RV resorts and parks provide a different sort of natural beauty while offering full access to all of the sights and attractions of the Alabama Gulf Coast. Just set up camp and, in no time, you will be sliding your feet luxuriously through white sands and splashing in our turquoise waters.
Luxury Camping 

With full water, sewer and electric hookups, WiFi, showers, laundry and friendly, courteous staff, Gulf Shores and Orange Beach RV parks offer all of the amenities to make your vacation one you will remember for years to come. In fact, you will probably want to reserve your space in advance for your next vacation in this RVer’s paradise.

A Whole Different State of Vacation

Whether it’s a summer vacation, a golf outing, Gulf Coast fishing trip or a winter retreat from the cold, an RV or camping stay in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach is an affordable and unique way to experience Southern hospitality and the beauty of the Gulf. Our RV parks offer easy access from Interstate-10. Just set up camp and, in no time, you will be sliding your feet luxuriously through white sand and splashing in our turquoise waters.

Great Way to Escape Winter

In case you didn't know, our temperatures are mild year-round. There is no ice or snow to be found on the Gulf Coast. The only thing white about Gulf Shores winters is the thirty-two miles of white sand beach. The only ice you'll see are the cubes clinking together pleasingly in your afternoon glass of refreshment. Join the many RVers who have discovered that an affordable stay at a Gulf Shores or Orange Beach RV park is a great way to escape the frigid gusts in other regions. Our sunny blue skies and Gulf breezes will warm away the winter chill.

Top Places To Stay With Beach Rentals & Watersports On Alabama’s Beaches
Accommodations with Beach Rentals & Water Sports
in Gulf Shores & Orange Beach
Published on: September 23, 2025
Updated at: May 14, 2026

When visiting Alabama’s Beaches, relaxing on the shore and exploring the Gulf with watersports are a must. We’ve compiled a list of places to stay where you can rent beach necessities like chairs and umbrellas, as well as water vessels such as Jet skis, kayaks, and banana boats. Whether you prefer relaxation or adventure, these accommodations with on-site rentals make hitting the beach a breeze.

Resorts with Beach Rentals & Water Sports

The resorts along our shores offer everything you need for an unforgettable coastal getaway, from restaurants and impressive pools to beach access and plenty of fun adventures. If you’re ready to hit the water, book a stay at one of these resorts, where you can fly over the waves on a Jet ski or relax on a sailboat cruise that you can book on-site.

1
Beach Club Resort & Spa

Beach Club Resort & Spa is a fabulous option for families with an inclusive experience catering to adults and kids. Guests at this full-service resort have direct beach access as well as beach chair and umbrella rentals. When you’re ready for a bit of excitement, check out the on-site water activities like banana boats, Jet skis, and paddleboards offered by Top Tier Watersports.

Book Now

2
Perdido Beach Resort

Perdido Beach Resort offers so much more than a place to sleep. This beachfront resort boasts five dining options, indoor and outdoor pools, beach gear rentals, and water rentals like paddleboards, kayaks, and pontoon boats. Guests can also easily book parasailing, cruises, and charter boat experiences on-site with local partners. When you stay here, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to make a splash.

Book Now

3
Caribe Resort

Sitting on the bay, The Caribe is a family-friendly condo-style resort with a private marina providing guests with many ways to explore the waterways and nearby islands. You’ll find Jet skis, kayaks, and pontoon boat rentals here. Additionally, several dolphin cruises and fishing charters depart from the marina. When you’re ready to relax, take a dip in one of the resort's several pools or float around the lazy river.

Book Now

Hotels Offering Beach Chair & Umbrella Rentals

If you plan to spend your beach vacation relaxing by the water with your toes in the sand, you’ll need the right beach gear to make your time along our shores comfortable. Thankfully, several beachfront hotels offer beach umbrellas and chair rentals, so you don’t need to worry about bringing your own or buying them from the store. These hotels are perfect for visitors flying into our destination or those traveling without their own gear.

4
Hilton Garden Inn Orange Beach

Guests at the Hilton Garden Inn Orange Beach can wake up and head straight down to the beach for a memorable day by the water. This beachfront hotel offers convenient chair and umbrella rentals set up in front of the hotel by Perdido Beach Services. While the hotel doesn’t provide water excursions, guests can easily reach local vendors offering paddleboards and Jet skis just down the beach.

Book Now

5
Phoenix All Suites Hotel

Travelers looking for a beachfront stay within walking distance of shops, restaurants, and attractions will love Phoenix All Suites Hotel. The hotel works with Ike’s Beach Service to offer guests beach chairs and umbrellas that are readily available to rent. Situated in the heart of Gulf Shores, this hotel is also conveniently located near Gulf Place (Gulf Shores Public Beach), where beachgoers can find water excursions like banana boats and parasailing. 

Book Now

6
The Tides

The Tides, Best Western Premier, sits just steps away from the Gulf and has a beachfront pool, two bars, and easy beach access. Guests can rent beach chairs and umbrellas through Perdido Beach Services, which will set up your gear directly in front of the hotel. Even when you’re not in the sand, you can still take in the gorgeous views from the hotel’s Gulf-facing lobby.

Book Now

Plan Your Beach Vacation with Built-In Water Sports & Beach Rentals

Our gorgeous Gulf waters and miles of white-sand shores are begging to be explored. Make your trip easier and more fun by conveniently enjoying our beaches at an accommodation with beach rentals and activities. These lodging options partner with local providers, so everything from chairs to Jet skis awaits just steps from your room. After all, the less time you spend picking up and hauling beach gear, the more time you have for exciting adventures or relaxation by the water! Book a stay with on-site beach rentals for your next vacation to Alabama’s Beaches.  

Even if you don't stay at an accommodation with on-site rentals, you can still rent beach chairs, umbrellas, wheelchairs, and other beach items from local outfitters who will deliver to you!

Explore Rentals on Alabama's Beaches

Whatever your vacation style, Alabama’s Beaches have the perfect spot for you. Start planning by choosing your dates and group size, and explore the best vacation rentals in Gulf Shores, comfortable places to stay in Orange Beach, or the charming rentals of Fort Morgan. With verified listings, secure payments, and real support, there are plenty of reasons why you should book with us.

Best Accommodations With Lazy Rivers On Alabama's Beaches
Lodging with Lazy Rivers
in Gulf Shores & Orange Beach
Published on: July 14, 2025
Updated at: May 14, 2026

A float in a lazy river is an experience that totally enhances a beach trip. They offer you even more opportunities for relaxation and fun on your trip without ever leaving your accommodation. The kids will have a blast winding through the pool area on innertubes while the adults can enjoy a relaxing float with a cold drink in hand. They’re also great for hitting the water on red flag days. If this sounds like a must-have for your vacation, consider staying at one of these condos and resorts with lazy rivers in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach.

Best Condos with Lazy Rivers

Condos are ideal for visitors wanting space, privacy, and home-like comforts. Access to full kitchens, living areas, and bedrooms offers families and friends spaces to hang out without leaving the condo. A lazy river adds extra value to your stay and provides another way for groups to unwind together.

1
Phoenix on the Bay

Phoenix on the Bay is a waterfront condo complex tucked away on Terry Cove in Orange Beach. This accommodation has a relaxing lazy river, an indoor and outdoor pool, a hot tub, and even a waterslide – perfect for entertaining kids. Additionally, Phoenix on the Bay offers boat slips and a launch, making it ideal for those wanting a boat-friendly vacation.

Book Now

2
Crystal Towers

Crystal Towers is a Gulf Shores condo that offers resort-like amenities such as a barbecue area, arcade, and ample parking. The condominium sits just across the beach and has a private air-conditioned skywalk leading to a Gulf-front pool, hot tub, lazy river, viewing deck, and beach access. On the condo property, guests can enjoy an indoor and outdoor pool, sauna, and hot tub.

Book Now

3
The Oasis

The Oasis is a recently renovated beachfront condominium that provides guests with an array of on-site amenities. Its outdoor pool area has a splash pad, lazy river, bar and grill, adults-only pool, waterslide, and gorgeous views of the Gulf. Guests can also take advantage of the half basketball courts, pickleball courts, barbecue area, indoor pool, sauna, arcade, and putting green. What more could you ask for?

Book Now

4
Phoenix Gulf Towers

Phoenix Gulf Towers I and II are new luxury condo developments on the beach. Their beachfront pool area includes a lazy river, outdoor pool, waterslide, splash pad, hot tubs, and an indoor heated pool. A boardwalk sits just a few steps away from the pool and provides easy, direct access to the beach. These condos offer two-, three-, and four-bedroom units so that you can bring your whole gang.  

Book Now

5
Phoenix West

Phoenix West is a popular beachfront condo that boasts a lazy river with scenic views of the beach and luscious palms scattered around it. Additionally, the pool area has a hot tub, waterslide, zero-entry pool, indoor pool and hot tubs, and direct beach access. You can take a float in the lazy river and then easily stroll down to the Gulf.

Book Now

Best Resorts with Lazy Rivers

Treat yourself to a beach trip to remember by booking a stay at a resort on Alabama’s Beaches. Whether you’re looking for an all-inclusive experience or a laid-back stay (with extra perks), you’ll have a blast floating in the lazy rivers at these incredible resorts.

6
The Caribe

The Caribe has just about everything you could ask for in a resort. When you stay here, you’ll find a fabulous rooftop lazy river and pool offering scenic views of the bay. This resort has additional pools on its lower decks with water slides, an indoor pool, hot tubs, a putting green, a mini golf course, a basketball court and tennis courts, bocce ball, and a full-service marina. Guests at The Caribe can hop on the convenient trolleys and take a short ride to the beach directly across the resort.

Book Now

Best Hotels with Lazy Rivers 

You don't have to give up the luxuries of a resort or condo when you stay at a hotel along Alabama's Beaches. The beachfront, boutique, and chain hotels across our destination offer guests a comfortable place to stay with coastal charm.

7
Hilton Garden Inn Orange Beach

As the only hotel on Alabama’s Beaches with a lazy river, the Hilton Garden Inn Orange Beach is the ultimate accommodation for those wanting fun in the sun with all the amenities of a chain hotel. This beachfront hotel is conveniently located within walking distance of several restaurants and stores. The hotel’s lazy river offers guests a relaxing spot to float and take in the scenic views of the shore.

Book Now

Book Your Stay

Lazy rivers are a hot commodity along our shores, especially during the spring and summer. If you see a property you like, we suggest snagging it early so you don’t miss out! Book now and get ready for an unforgettable vacation on Alabama’s Beaches.

Explore Rentals on Alabama's Beaches

Whatever your vacation style, Alabama’s Beaches have the perfect spot for you. Start planning by choosing your dates and group size, and explore the best vacation rentals in Gulf Shores, comfortable places to stay in Orange Beach, or the charming rentals of Fort Morgan. With verified listings, secure payments, and real support, there are plenty of reasons why you should book with us.

Condos & Resorts With Water Slides On Alabama’s Beaches
Condos & Resorts with Waterslides
in Gulf Shores & Orange Beach
Published on: September 9, 2025
Updated at: May 14, 2026

Alabama’s Beaches are the ideal destination for a memorable family vacation. Our area offers white-sand beaches, fantastic coastal cuisine, and plenty of ways to make a splash. The perfect beach vacation filled with fun calls for an accommodation that elevates your trip experience. Take your beach getaway to the next level with a condo or resort that has a waterslide. This amenity is great for travelers with kids, keeping them happy and entertained. Check out these condos and resorts in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach that have pools with waterslides!

Top Family Accommodations with Waterslides
1
The Oasis

The Oasis keeps guests entertained from the moment they set foot on the property. From an arcade and putting green to a lazy river and splash pad, there is so much to do at this beachfront condo. When you’re ready to cool off, make a splash into the Gulf-facing pool by going down the waterslide.  

Book Now

2
The Caribe

The Caribe is a pool lover’s paradise. This luxury, family-friendly resort sits between the Gulf and the bay and offers incredible on-site amenities. Visitors will have a blast swimming in several pools, floating in the lazy rivers, or zipping down the various waterslides. Its prime location offers easy access to both the beach and the bay.

Book Now

3
Phoenix Properties

You're in for a fun-filled vacation when you stay at a Phoenix condo. Each property boasts its own unique amenities, such as lazy rivers, tennis courts, and indoor pools, and several Phoenix properties have waterslides at their pools. These properties include Phoenix Gulf Towers, Phoenix Orange Beach, Phoenix Orange Beach II, Phoenix Gulf Shores, Phoenix Gulf Shores II, and Phoenix West. Book a stay at any of these condos and enjoy slipping down the waterslides.

Book Now 

4
Turquoise Place

Families with kids will have a blast at Turquoise Place, a beachfront resort bursting with activities and entertainment. The pool area features a snowcone bar, poolside grill, 450-foot lazy river, splash pad, and a four-story waterslide. Additionally, each unit has a private hot tub on the balcony. If you’re up for more fun, check out the putting green, tennis and pickleball courts, and family activity center.

Book Now

5
Phoenix on the Bay

Phoenix on the Bay is a gorgeous waterfront resort tucked away in Terry Cove. While exploring this expansive property, you’ll enjoy a lazy river, shaded pool areas, a putting green, and a waterslide. This condo is also great for boaters as it has a marina, boat slips, and a boat launch.

Book Now

Local Waterparks
Waterville

You can experience even more water fun at Waterville USA. This local waterpark has been a staple of Alabama’s Beaches for decades but has plenty of new attractions among its 20-acre park. Float in the wave pool, race down the waterslides, or test your surfing skills on the Flowrider. The little ones will have a blast splashing in the Shrimp Boat Village and WaWa World water playgrounds.

Tropic Falls

A short drive to Foley will lead you to Tropic Falls, a family-friendly amusement and waterpark. The waterpark is covered by a retractable roof and is the largest indoor park in the region. Here, you’ll find multiple slides, a water playground, a lazy river, and an outdoor wave pool. Because most of the attractions are indoors, it’s a fabulous rainy day or cold weather activity.

Choose from a Variety of Accommodations on Alabama's Beaches 

No matter your vacation preferences and needs, Gulf Shores and Orange Beach have the lodging options to make it happen. 

We’ve got the perfect place in the sand for you on Alabama’s Beaches. From spacious condos and beach houses in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach and charming rentals in Fort Morgan to gorgeous beachfront accommodations, you’ll find just what you need for your vacation on our beaches.

From trip planning to setting foot in Alabama’s Beaches, local experts are ready to help you find the best place to stay for you and your crew. Our lodging partners offer a wide variety of amenities that fit your families individual needs, even the furry family members. Year after year, visitors return to the Alabama Gulf Coast to experience true Southern hospitality and breathtaking views all while making unforgettable memories. 

Choose from a variety of vacation rentals in Gulf Shores, Orange Beach and Fort Morgan, including  beach houses, condominiums, resorts,  hotels, cabins, RV parks and campgrounds and bed & breakfasts. We also offer pet-friendly vacation rentals. 

Beach Houses

Want to relax and unwind while enjoying beautiful Gulf views with lots of space? A beach house vacation rental in Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, or Fort Morgan is just what you are looking for. Many vacation homes are beachfront properties, offering private pools, decks, grills, laundry facilities and private beachside dune walk-overs to the beach. 

Condominiums

Choose between Gulf front, bay front and lagoon and back bay views in Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan. These condominiums offer amenities like tennis courts, pools, golf course access, and full-service spas. Whether you're looking for a luxury stay or a budget-friendly option, there’s a condo rental with the perfect amenities for you and your family.

Resorts

Staying at a beachfront resort in Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, or Fort Morgan offers all the conveniences of home with extra luxuries. Choose from a variety of resorts that offer on-site dining, spas, private pools, and stunning views. Perfect for a quiet couple’s escape or an exciting family adventure, these resorts offer the ideal mix of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm along Alabama's Gulf Coast. 

Hotels

Staying at any of our hotels comes with friendly staff and Southern hospitality that will make you feel at home from the moment you arrive, except home never had our magnificent views of our shores. Enjoy easy access to attractions and relax knowing every detail of your stay is handled with care, so you can focus on making the most of your Alabama’s Beaches vacation.

Cabins

Cabins offer guests the chance to disconnect from the world around them and reconnect with nature without giving up the comfort and convenience of a relaxing vacation. You’ll be surrounded by a diverse array of local plant life and wildlife while enjoying the various amenities provided by your rental. Imagine waking up to the soft rustling of leaves, sipping coffee on a cozy porch, and savoring the peaceful beauty of Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan.

RV Parks & Campgrounds

If you have a passion for the outdoors, Gulf Shores and Orange Beach offer RV (recreational vehicle) parks for those who like to stay connected to nature. Most campgrounds and RV parks include amenities such as water and electric hookups, WiFi (check for free WiFi on a property basis), bathhouses, laundry facilities, and other extras: combining ultimate convenience with your naturistic vacation. Relax under Alabama’s starry skies, grill by your campsite, and wake up with the sounds of nature around you.

Bed & Breakfast

For those who want to experience Southern hospitality in a more personal setting, a bed & breakfast may be the perfect getaway. Convenient to the beaches, sights and activities of Alabama's Beaches, they offer a more intimate lodging alternative.

Pet-Friendly Lodging

No vacation is complete without your trusted companion. That’s why Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan offer several pet-friendly hotels and rental options to welcome your entire family. From taking a stroll in one of our nature parks to pet-friendly restaurants, these coastal towns are pet-friendly destinations and welcome your furry friends. Enjoy a getaway where you and your pets can explore Alabama’s Beaches together!

Why Book
With Us

Our direct booking experience saves time and removes stress thanks to verified listings, secure payments, and real support. When you book on our site, you can rest easy knowing you are working with local, trusted professionals.

Book Now

Where to Stay on Alabama’s Beaches: Find Your Ideal Location

Discover Alabama’s beach vacation rentals along the Gulf Coast in three unique destinations: the lively Gulf Shores, relaxed Orange Beach, and quiet, Historic Fort Morgan. Each location offers a special way to enjoy your Gulf Coast getaway.

Gulf Shores

Gulf Shores is lively and family-friendly, making it perfect for travelers seeking a blend of relaxation and fun. With stunning beaches, boardwalks, and attractions, Gulf Shores vacation rentals are ideal for families, couples, and groups who enjoy plenty of dining and entertainment options.

Orange Beach

Known for its laid-back charm, Orange Beach is a haven for those who love water sports and scenic coastal beauty. With marinas, nature trails, and beachfront parks, Orange Beach rentals are perfect for active travelers and those looking for a peaceful, nature-filled escape.

Fort Morgan

For a more secluded and historic experience, Fort Morgan offers tranquil, unspoiled beaches and rich history. Fort Morgan rentals are ideal for nature lovers and history buffs looking for a quiet, serene getaway away from the crowds.

Find Your Coastal Retreat on Alabama’s Beaches 

Step into your dream vacation on Alabama’s Beaches, where every rental is a doorway to coastal charm and adventure. Picture mornings by the waves in a beach house, cozy nights in a Gulf-view condo, or peaceful afternoons in a hidden cabin retreat. From Gulf Shores to Orange Beach and Fort Morgan, find the rental that fits your style, book with ease, and let the relaxation and joy of the Gulf Coast surround you. Book your rental today and make Alabama’s Beaches your next getaway.

Beaches

In Gulf Shores and Orange Beach, the name tells the story – miles of pristine white quartz sand washed by blue-green Gulf waters. Please be advised that there will be no lifeguards on duty on Gulf Shores and Orange Beach public beaches from October through February. During this time, beach patrol and response will be limited. Always check the beach flags and surf conditions, before entering the water, and never swim alone. For those interested in open water swimming tips, remember to stay informed and cautious. Help keep Alabama's Beaches pristine by practicing responsible tourism and following beach rules & regulations. 

Parking kiosks are now in place at most beaches. You can find more information about parking in Gulf Shores and parking in Orange Beach.

Beach goers at Alabama Point East public access can borrow life jackets while enjoying their time on the beach. These life jackets are free and are available in various sizes. We encourage children and those who aren’t strong swimmers to take advantage of these vests. Remember to return them before you leave.

For those looking for wheelchair-accessible beach access points, there are three beach mats located at Gulf Place and one located at Cotton Bayou. 

Maximize your beach time by booking a waterfront place to stay directly on our site and wake up to the sound of the waves!

Know Before You Go

Alabama's Instagrammable Moments

 

play_arrow
Beach
Vibes

Discover Alabama’s Gulf Coast and visit Gulf Shores & Orange Beach. Enjoy warm sunshine, deep history and culture alongside unspoiled natural beauty. Walk along the 32 miles of white-sand beaches and find yourself in a state of serenity and relaxation.

Explore one of America’s hidden gem locations and you’ll realize why so many people return year after year to sink their toes back in the sand. You’ll never want to miss another Gulf Coast sunset after you see how spectacular they can be.

While you’re here, visit the Gulf State Park and Gulf Shores Public Beach with picnic tables, public restrooms, private showers, and more. Make sure you come prepared with your rentals so you can get in on the fun.

'Tis The Sea-Sun
Gulf Shores Main Public Beach (Gulf Place)

Everyone loves Gulf Place Beach. This beach features plenty of things to do including sandy beach bars, eateries, beach boutique stores, pavilions, picnic areas, watersports, volleyball and beach hotels that let you stay and play. Highway 59 dead-ends at the main beach area, but there is public access up and down the coast. 

Gulf State Park Beach

Gulf State Park offers a whirl of activities including boating, paddle boarding, fishing, from the Gulf State Park Pier, biking, golfing and camping. There’s even a play area just for dogs located at Lake Shelby on the park’s western end. From the main entrance at the Beach Pavilion in Gulf Shores, there are access points along Orange Beach (including Alabama Point East).

Cotton Bayou

Cotton Bayou is set at the intersection of Highways 182 and 161 in Orange Beach and also part of Gulf State Park. Cotton Bayou is small in size but big on amenities, including outdoor showers and ample free parking. This beach is located within convenient walking distance of the primary Orange Beach condominiums. 

Shore Excursion

Some beach goers plant their towels, open a good book and start working on the ultimate tan. Others like to stir things up with parasailing, kayaking and excursions to nearby islands. If you’re staying close to shore, a flood of beach equipment rentals will be on hand – beach bikes, buggies, beach wheelchairs, paddle boards, surf and skim boards and all kinds of flotation devices. Many companies offer delivery and pick-up service.

Beach Safety

When visiting Gulf Shores and Orange Beach, it is important to remember beach safety and to be respectful of animal's natural habitats. Don’t forget the sunscreen before venturing out in the warm Alabama sunshine. Take care when exploring the sand. You might happen upon a sea turtle nest or a tiny bird’s nest. Please keep off the sand dunes. They preserve natural habitats. Take nothing but pictures and leave only footprints. Observe and obey the beach flag warning system. Check our Beach Safety Page for daily updates.

Must-See & Must-Do on Alabama's Beaches

With dozens of family-friendly activities and coastal attractions in Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan, you're sure to find something memorable for you and the whole family. From thrilling helicopter tours to waterparks to mini golf courses and historic sites, our shoreline offers a variety of fun outdoor adventures for those sunny Alabama days. We even offer unique rainy-day activities for the few rainy days we might encounter, ensuring your vacation plans stay on track.

Discover Attractions Along Alabama's Beaches 

Family Fun & Amusements
High-Speed Theme Park Action
Waterville, USA

With names like Triple Dog Dare, Jet Stream, and Screamin' Demon, you know some serious water slides are waiting for you at Waterville USA. This 20-acre water and amusement park delivers high-speed thrills, but you can also slow it down on a lazy river, challenge the wave pool, or channel your inner dude on a surfboard simulator. Separate children's areas include Wa Wa World, while landlubbers enjoy a wooden rollercoaster, high-speed go-karts, and an Escape House.

The Track Family Fun Park

Steer into excitement at this premier amusement hub, The Track, featuring multi-level go-karting, bumper boat rides, and the heart-stopping Skycoaster, which stimulates the rush of skydiving with a safety harness at speeds up to 70 mph.

Indoor Play & Competition
The Factory

For kids and the young at heart, the sheer joy of jumping is multiplied at The Factory, whose indoor trampoline park covers 12,000 square feet. This climate controlled sports and entertainment center offers much more for those who came to pray, including trapezes, slides, foam pits, dodgeball, arcade games, and flight simulators.

Mini-Golf

Groups and families up for a little friendly competition can tee off on one of many themed mini-golf courses along Alabama's Beaches.

Arcades

When it's time to beat the heat, there are plenty of arcades in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach with classic and interactive games for off-the-beach fun.

Wildlife & Natural Wonders
Animal Encounters at the Zoo

Many people vacation here to enjoy our white-sand beaches, but also to bear witness to our unique coastal nature and exotic animals. The Alabama Gulf Coast Zoo is home to over 500 exotic animals, including lions, primates, wolves, and reptiles. You can even get close and personal with animals like giraffes, lemurs, tortoises, and sloths through their popular animal encounters.

Landmark Entertainment & Culture
Shopping & Dining at The Wharf

You won't know what to do first at The Wharf in Orange Beach, an official entertainment district. For starters, the Wharf is home to one of the largest Ferris wheels in the Southeast. There are also dozens of shops, excursions from the marina, and a free, nighttime laser light show. If you need a break from all that activity, sit back and enjoy live performances in the 10,000-seat Wharf Amphitheater. Wherever you find yourself on the Wharf, there's enjoyment, dining, and entertainment waiting. 

Historic Forts and Local Museums

For history buffs, our destination offers several museums in Orange Beach and Gulf Shores. Visit the Historic Fort Morgan to explore the grounds of the pre-Civil War masonry, or travel to the nearby USS ALABAMA Battleship Memorial Park to marvel at massive antique ships and aviation history.

Art Galleries & Experiences

Whether you like to admire art or create your own masterpieces, Gulf Shores and Orange Beach boast several experiences for art enthusiasts. The expansive collections at The Coastal Arts Center, The Gulf Coast Arts Alliance, and Sea Oat Studio feature various works from local and regional artists. When you're ready to let your creative juices flow, book a hands-on class at The Hot Shop or The Clay Studio.

Free & Budget-Friendly Attractions

Many of the area's incredible coastal experiences don't require a ticket, as there are plenty of free and cheap things to do. From free museums, escape rooms, and movie theaters. These free & budget-friendly attractions will keep the fun going for the whole family. Whether you're planning a full vacation or just a spontaneous day out, there are endless ways to make lasting memories without stretching your budget.

 View Cheap & Free Things To Do

Rainy Day, No Problem!

A rainy day at the beach is still a good one! Bad weather won't stall a vacation on Alabama's Beaches thanks to indoor attractions like arcades, museums, escape rooms, and movie theaters. These rainy-day activities will keep the fun going for the whole family, as they're more than just backups but noteworthy spots to visit.

Take a look at all of the great sights and experiences available for your Gulf Shores & Orange Beach vacation. Whether you’re visiting as a family, on a couple’s getaway, and taking a trip with friends, Gulf Shores & Orange Beach is your ideal relaxing, restful, or playful beach vacation destination.

When you visit Gulf Shores & Orange Beach, you’ll have the opportunity to visit our white-sand beaches and head out into the waters for a variety of exciting activities. Parasail and get a bird’s-eye view of the area, kayak to calmly explore our waterways, fish for your next great catch, or head out on a cruise to possibly catch a glimpse of our neighboring dolphins.

Fun

Looking for something to do once you exit our amazing white-sand beaches? Miniature golf, dolphin cruises, bowling, ferry trips and horseback riding are just some of the fun to be had during Gulf Coast vacations. With arcades, a zoo, a water park, amusement parks and more you’ll find enjoyable activities for the entire family – from adults to children of all ages – all in one place. Find Yourself Wandering
Hiking

According to the Nature Conservancy and several other sources, Alabama ranks as one of the top five most biodiverse states. That means nature lovers will be enthralled when walking through the natural setting and extensive species that live on Alabama's coast. Orange Beach and Gulf Shores hiking paths, trails, and preserves are all ways to explore the distinct ecosystems of the area. You may even see one of the rare species (including the gopher tortoise, Alabama beach mouse and red-cockaded woodpecker) that call the region home.

Active travelers gravitate to trails like the Hugh S. Branyon Backcountry Trail. There are seven trails and six ecosystems where you can see bobcats, white-tailed deer, alligators and numerous birds. Be sure to bring your camera!

Another popular outdoor spot is the Bon Secour National Wildlife Refuge. Depending on the time of year, you may see a monarch migration or sea turtle nesting season. There are plenty of potential wildlife sightings whenever you decide to go. At Bon Secour, you’ll have ample opportunities to learn about the refuge while having an excellent nature adventure.

Biking Trails

Whether you bring your bike or rent one, you can try cycling your way through interconnecting bike systems in the Gulf Shores area. Pack a lunch and get your exercise on the trails, all while enjoying the shady trees and impeccable landscape. You’ll probably spy some birds or other creatures among the extensive foliage. Some of the top biking spots are the Fort Morgan Road Trail and the Coyote Crossing Trail, which is a new addition to the Hugh S. Branyon Backcountry Trail’s 27 miles of paved road.

Birding

You can’t visit Gulf Shores and Orange Beach without hearing about the Alabama Coastal Birding Trail. Bird lovers consider this area a bucket list destination due to the many species that pass through the site. Hummingbirds, herons and snowy plovers are just a few birds that take to the air and water. If you want to learn more about birds, there is also an annual Alabama Coastal BirdFest in October. The festival features exhibits, raptor shows, and kids’ activities. Whether you are new to the birding world or have been birdwatching for years, it’s a festival for everyone.

Golf

Golfing in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach is a popular activity for active travel and outdoor enthusiasts, as visitors can access courses designed by champions. The area has fifteen courses, giving you plenty of options to practice your long shot or combine smaller greens and different challenges. Some tracks are designed by golfing greats like Arnold Palmer, Jerry Pate and The South’s own Earl Jones. Each course highlights the beautiful scenery of the region. Your biggest dilemma will be choosing which course you want to play.

History

Fort Morgan isn’t just a great excuse to get outside but also gives you a glimpse into Alabama’s rich history. The Mobile Bay Civil War Trail runs 90 miles from the Gulf to north Mobile County. Along the way, there are opportunities to take in the natural surroundings and learn about battle sites through historical accounts. It's a beautiful journey through history as you follow military movements, battles and visit sites that show how soldiers lived during that time.

Guided Tours in Gulf Shores & Orange Beach

From Segway tours, sunset cruises on a boat and educational pier walks by the beach to kayaking excursions and dolphin cruises, booking a guided tour in Gulf Shores & Orange Beach is a fantastic way to explore the coastal destination while also gaining facts and other information about the Alabama Gulf Coast. Our Gulf Shores & Orange Beach tour guides are here to help you make the most of your Alabama getaway by sharing everything they know about the area and wildlife.

Dive In
Dolphin Tours

Gulf Shores and Orange Beach are famous for their accessibility to dolphins via cruises and tours. Enjoy your time on a boat as you get up close and personal to these playful majestic creatures as they swim alongside your vessel. Dolphin cruises are amongst our most popular tourist attractions on Alabama's Gulf Coast.

Kayak Tours

Sure, you could rent a kayak and go off on your own, but here’s what’s waiting for you in a kayak tour:

A boat ride to the hidden-away places, known only to the guides and only accessible by kayak
Glimpsing osprey, pelicans blue herons and pelicans
Getting up close to playful dolphins
A relaxing and surreal experience you’ll never forget
Segway Tours

Why walk when you can roll? And let’s face it; Segways are just cool. After a quick tutorial on how to operate them and stay balanced, you’re off on fun guided adventures through backcountry trails where your guide will point out birds, deer, and other animals. Segway tours are a low-intensity activity suitable for all ages while also giving you a thrill of driving a fun motorized toy!

Exploring Outdoors
Hot-Air Balloon Tours

It’s up, up and away on a hot-air balloon flight over Gulf Shores and Orange Beach, gently soaring over bays, bayous, and beaches. Flights generally take place in the early morning or later evening when the winds are lightest. Hot air balloon rides are an adventurous activity, perfect for a couple's vacation or a small group.

Helicopter Tours

Taking off from Gulf Shores Airport, helicopter tours offer a variety of choices. Go purely scenic, flying above the dazzling Gulf Shores and Orange Beach shoreline for the best view you've ever seen. Or take a ride into the past, flying over the Civil War-era Fort Morgan and nearby Fort Gaines. From a helicopter at that height, you’ll be able to spot shipwrecks resting on Alabama's Gulf sands as well fish and dolphin swimming below.

Delta Safari Tours

An ecotourism jewel just north of Mobile Bay, the Mobile-Tensaw River Delta includes a variety of habitats, including cypress swamps, brackish marshes, bottomland forests and underwater grass beds. A number of tour operators lead expeditions and delta safaris into the state’s largest wetland. Explore via airboat or tour boat. Either way, you will definitely see alligators.

Ready to see a tour of Alabama's magical Gulf Coast? Book your tour in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach today! Don't forget to also book your lodging accommodations, including Gulf Shores and Orange Beach hotels, beach condos, and house rentals!

Souvenir Hunting

When shopping souvenirs for the folks back home, you have to buy yourself a special gift too. Our eclectic boutiques and beach souvenir shops will help you find the perfect items from jewelry, t-shirts, farm-fresh pecans or something locally crafted like works of art or handmade bath and body products. From Souvenir City and Surf Style to House of Jerky and High Cotton Bath Co., Alabama's Beaches hosts many unique shops with the perfect souvenir waiting for you. 

Entertainment District

Shopping transitions into much more at our many multi-faceted entertainment districts featuring dining, attractions, local spas, rides and games, ice cream and coffee shops. You can even take a watersports break during your shopping day. A number of store districts also include onsite marinas offering dolphin cruises, deep-sea fishing, snorkeling and diving excursions, parasailing and jet skiing. Visit The Wharf or SanRoc Cay for an elevated shopping experience.

Beachy Boutiques

If fashion is your passion, look no further than national retailers or beachy clothing boutiques for resort-style casuals and fun accessories. Make sure to bring your new vacation clothes on your next visit or wear them at home to bring you back to the peaceful, sunny Gulf Shores. Headed to Alabama's Beaches with your girls? We have all the tools to help you plan a girls getaway!

Outdoor Shopping

An added bonus of shopping in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach is how our shopping enclaves and promenades are al fresco. This means your treasure hunt will be accompanied by abundant sunshine and balmy warmth as you stroll landscaped streets past whimsical fountains and performance artists.

Our strip malls, shopping centers, and outlets are packed with plenty of shopping opportunities to satisfy that hole in your pocket. Treat yourself while on vacation and explore all of the Gulf Shores & Orange Beach stores you can.

Local Bars

If you want the Gulf Shores and Orange Beach local experience, visit some local bars. Take a seat at the bar and order a Bushwacker while getting to know the locals and others visiting from out of town. If you're looking for a place to kick back and relax, you'll find lounges and sports bars where you can do that.

Live Music

There's always music playing in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach. From country singer-songwriters to Cajun dancing music, you'll find some of the best of the Gulf Shores and Orange Beach nightlife scene. Be sure to check the Calendar of Events to find out what live entertainment you can catch when you're in town. If you're visiting at the end of May, try to make it to the Sand in My Boots Festival. This year's lineup includes Morgan Wallen, Post Malone, Brooks and Dunn, and more of the biggest names in music. 

Girls or Guys Night Out

Get the group together and plan your night out. From bachelor parties to birthday blowouts, Gulf Shores and Orange Beach offer the perfect spots for celebrating. Hit the Flora Bama, order a round of fruity drinks at a Tiki Bar or toast to your vacation together with a craft cocktail. For a calmer night out, visit Crush Wines at The Wharf. Gulf Shores & Orange Beach have all the tools to help you plan a girls getaway or a guys trip.

Rain showers are just intermissions, with snacks.

Rainy Day Things to Do

Learning and Creating

Learn more about the local ecosystem when you take a trip to the Estuarium, with over 100 coastal species to see up close. The facility has 31 aquariums, exhibits, hands-on activities and experts to answer your questions. Another great way to spend the day indoors is to get creative and learn a new skill. There are ample opportunities to take art classes in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach. The Coastal Arts Center in Orange Beach is known for glass blowing. It offers classes and demonstrations, as well as pieces for sale.

Museums

Do you have history lovers in your group? They might be interested in stopping by the museums in the area. The Gulf Shores Museum has free admission to explore a historical home. Visit during a rainy day, and learn about the history of the city from friendly guides. The museums often host lectures and show movies highlighting events in Gulf Shores history.

In Gulf Shores & Orange Beach

Art and Culture

Whether you like looking at art, or you're looking for a piece to purchase and bring back home, you'll enjoy the local artists that call Gulf Shores home. Gulf Coast Arts Alliance is a great place to start, with a gallery that features over 50 local artists. You'll find several other small galleries and art shops throughout the area, each with incredible, unique pieces that showcase the style, culture and flair of the area. 

Fun and Games

Looking for a family-friendly activity that doesn't involve being outdoors? There's still fun to be had away from the beach. Visit Fat Daddy's Arcade for arcade games that the whole family can enjoy. Adventure Island is home to over 100 games, a rock wall, and a roller coaster simulator - allowing you to enjoy the thrill of amusement park rides while staying indoors.

Shopping

If you're in the mood for retail therapy, you're in luck. Spend an afternoon out of the elements checking out local shops and well known stores. The Tanger Outlets offer over 120 stores to visit, including favorite brands at discounted prices. For some local gulf flavor, visit the smaller shops around town where you'll find everything from handmade jewelry to cute souvenirs that will remind you of your trip to Alabama.

Rain or shine, you'll always have a good time at Gulf Shores and Orange Beach. Be sure to look at the calendar of events to see what will be happening around town while you're visiting the area and start making your list of rainy day activities. Request a vacation guide to find out what else the area has to offer and plan a Gulf Coast vacation today!

Hiking & Walking Trails in Gulf Shores & Orange Beach

Whether you want to take a relaxing stroll or want to get your heart pumping, the Alabama Gulf Coast is a hiker’s paradise. You might even spot an alligator basking in the sun, a white-tailed deer grazing on foliage, a pod of dolphins jumping through the waves or some migratory birds fluttering from tree to tree. You're invited to explore our natural beauty.
