Outdoor Things to Do

Wander the Great Outdoors

Explore the nine different ecosystems in Gulf State Park from coastal dunes, maritime forests to coastal hardwood swamps. And hike more than 27 miles of paved paths on the Hugh S. Branyon Backcountry Trail. Stop off at the nature center to learn about native plants and see live animal exhibits including snakes, owls, and rabbits. The park also offers guided nature walks, beach walks, pier walks and other educational programs.

For some unspoiled natural beauty containing a variety of wildlife, check out the Alabama Gulf Coast’s nature preserves and wildlife refuges. Commune with nature at Bon Secour National Wildlife Refuge, view colorful migratory birds through your binoculars along the Alabama Coastal Birding Trail or take in the beauty of the scenic waterways as you walk along the natural shorelines.

Breathe in the fresh air and soak up the sunshine while you walk along the different trails. You will want to return to the hiker’s haven to explore everything Gulf Shores and Orange Beach have to offer.

The Wharf In Orange Beach
The Heart of Entertainment

The Wharf is a lively, waterfront destination in Orange Beach where dining, shopping, entertainment, and events all come together in one coastal hub. This family-friendly (and pet-friendly) entertainment district offers fun and memorable experiences all year long, day and night. Stroll through the area’s array of stores during the day, then grab a few drinks and head to a concert under the stars at night. With exquisite restaurants, local shops, and one-of-a-kind attractions, The Wharf is a must-visit spot for visitors on Alabama’s Beaches.  

Things to Do
Events
Book Now
Shopping, Dining, and More

Dining, entertainment, and shopping seamlessly come together at The Wharf, creating an experience for all ages. From diverse restaurants and lively bars to family-friendly attractions like arcades, a movie theater, live music, and a towering Ferris wheel, there’s always something happening. Stroll the walkable district to browse local boutiques, specialty shops, and coastal finds perfect for taking a piece of the beach home.

Things To Do
Gulf State Park
Nature, Trails, and Coastal Adventure Awaits

Gulf State Park has become a mecca for lovers of the great outdoors vacationing on the Alabama Gulf Coast. A destination within the destination, there’s so much to see and do within the park’s 6,150 acres and 28 miles of trails. Scroll down to learn more about the activities and other things to do at Gulf State Park.
 

Discover the Gulf State Park
ACTIVITIES & THINGS TO DO
HUGH S. BRANYON BACKCOUNTY TRAIL
LAKE SHELBY
EDUCATIONAL OPPORTUNITIES
DINING
ACCOMMODATIONS
Watch Visual Stories

Discover the Gulf State Park

Coastal Code
#11

26 mph isn't just a speed limit, it's a way of life.

Things to Do in Gulf State Park

play_arrow
Let's
Hike

Adjacent to Alabama's Beaches is Gulf State Park, with 6000 acres spanning the Alabama Gulf Coast, and is home to nine unique ecosystems. Once in the park, you will find three lakes, trails, dining, and lodging. You also can't forget the three-and-a-half miles of beach for you to enjoy. Whether you like relaxing or want to take an adventure, Gulf State Park has something for everyone to enjoy.

Contact Information for The Gulf State Park
Explore the Gulf State Park

Discover and explore all that the Gulf State Park has to offer. From expansive trails to fabulous dining, the GSP offers it all.

 

Share Your Best Gulf State Park Memories

From scenic trails to sunset views, Gulf State Park is full of unforgettable moments. See how others explore the park and share your own. #VisitAlabamasBeaches

What's New On Alabama's Beaches
Discover What's New
in Gulf Shores & Orange Beach
Published on: January 6, 2026
Updated at: May 14, 2026

If Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan are “your beaches,” then by all means, you’ll want to know what’s new since your last visit. From lodging accommodations, restaurants, attractions, and much more, don’t miss a beat with this list of what's new on Alabama's Beaches!

New Restaurants & Things to Do on Alabama's Beaches
1
Anchored Coffee House

Need a caffeine boost? Head to Anchored Coffee House in Gulf Shores for coffee. Whether you like it iced, hot, or frozen, they've got you covered with a freshly brewed cup.

2
Pho-Mo Asian Kitchen & Grill

Pho, dumplings, egg rolls, and fried rice are a few of the tempting offerings on the menu at Pho-Mo Asian Kitchen. This local, family-run restaurant also has insane smash burgers for those craving something from the grill.

3
Eco-Center

The Gulf Coast Eco-Center is the hub for all things environmental on Alabama's Beaches. Boasting summer camps, community programs, outdoor adventures, and public classes, it's a must-visit for nature lovers.

4
Fresco

Fresh ingredients, Italian-inspired cuisine, and a relaxing atmosphere come together at Fresco in Bon Secour. This restaurant offers handmade pastas and pizzas, exquisite desserts, and easy take-out meals for those who want delicious dining on the go.

5
Portside at The Wharf

The latest addition to The Wharf in Orange Beach, Portside boasts local shops and boutiques, dining options, and family-friendly attractions. At the center of the area sits a grassy lawn with yard games, Adirondack chairs, and a covered stage, where The Wharf hosts live music, game days, and movies nights.

6
Sunliner Diner Orange Beach

Fans of the iconic Sunliner Diner are in luck. The retro breakfast and burger spot now has a second location in Orange Beach, so you have double the opportunities to sip on milkshakes and listen to tunes on the jukebox.

7
Bagel Boy

Speaking of breakfast, start your day at Bagel Boy. Whether you like your bagels covered in shmear, eggs, sausage, or hot sauce, this beach spot has a menu filled with classic bagels and breakfast sandwiches. 

8
Phoenix Gulf Shores II

Phoenix Gulf Shores II is the newest addition by Brett/Robison Vacation Rentals. This Gulf-facing condominium features modern 3- and 4-bedroom units with spacious balconies. Other amenities include a lazy river, outdoor and indoor pools, on-site beach chair rentals, and a beachfront boardwalk.

9
Nami Sushi

Satisfy your craving for Japanese cuisine at Nami Sushi. Keep it classic with a few sushi rolls and bento boxes or try something new and feast on a sushi pizza. You won't refer it.

10
Mythic Beach Banana Bar

Got a sweet tooth? Fix it with one of the frozen and irresistible treats at Mythic Beach Banana Bar. This beachfront shop serves dipped bananas, ice cream sandwiches, and cheesecakes ,covered in toppings and drizzled with sauce.

11
Circle & GoBoats

If you're looking for a new and exciting way to explore the water, rent a vessel from Beachside Circle Boats or Exotic Aquatics GoBoats. These inflatable boats offer one of the coolest rides around. Cruise to the islands or float down the Intracoastal.

12
Embassy Suites

Sitting across from West Beach, Embassy Suites offers guests an incredible lodging experience with easy access to the water, local restaurants, and nearby shops. The modern Hilton hotel boasts a rooftop bar, on-site dining, an outdoor pool, and complimentary breakfast.

13
Pub 6

When it's time for a pint and mouthwatering bar food, visit Pub 6. This fun, neighborhood pub is open for lunch and dinner, offering bites such as smash burgers, tacos, and wings. It's a fantastic spot to spend game day.

14
ShoreFizz

Cool off after a day on the beach with a sweet drink at ShoreFizz. This cute soda shop serves dirty sodas, lemonades, milkshakes, and ice cream - the perfect treat for summer.

15
Gulf Babe Wine Boutique

Gulf Babe Wine Boutique is a chic and charming bar in Portside at The Wharf that serves gorgeous cocktails, tasty charcuterie boards, and a variety of wines from across the world. The charming decor and welcoming atmosphere invite guests in for a sip and a bite both afternoon and night.

16
Community Fly Supply

Whether you're an avid angler or want to dive into fly fishing on Alabama's Beaches, Community Fly Supply is the go-to spot for all things fly fishing. This shop offers custom flies, fly rods, reels, and accessories. The experts here also provide lessons on fly casting and fly tying and are happy to help pass along their knowledge to others interested in casting off along our waterways. 

17
Tee Off

Test your skills at Tee Off at The Wharf. Powered by TopGolf, this modern bar and restaurant has several private SwingSuites for guests to play a variety of games. Order a few apps and drinks and start swinging!

18
SpringHill Suites

Just across from the shore and overflowing with amenities, SpringHill Suites Orange Beach is a chain hotel offering guests a luxury experience. This Marriott hotel has a stunning outdoor pool, a bistro and bar, spacious rooms, complimentary breakfast, fire pits and grills, and a 24-hour fitness center.

Fun Family Beach Activities
Fun Family Activities
in Gulf Shores & Orange Beach
Published on: January 7, 2026
Updated at: May 14, 2026

At the top of everyone’s planning-for-vacation list comes the question—how can I entertain everyone in the family, from toddlers to teens? Alabama’s Beaches are the perfect spot for a family vacay because there is something for every age and stage. From water activities and nature adventures to competitive attractions and animal encounters, your family will have a blast in Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan.

Best Activities for Families on Alabama's Beaches
1
Take a Course in Sandcastle Building

You’re bound to hit the beach a few times during your visit. While playing in the sand, take a lesson from the pros at Sand Castle University and learn how to craft the perfect sculptures. All ages and skill levels are welcome to this unique experience that helps everyone become an expert in this beach pastime. Sand Castle University will provide all the equipment and expertise needed. Hop out of your beach chair and dig your hands and feet into the sand!

2
Get a Bird’s-Eye View of the Area

It’s hard to visit Orange Beach without stopping by The Wharf to get a little shopping, dining, and playing in during your vacation. While you’re here, take a ride on The Wharf’s Ferris Wheel. Both kids and adults will enjoy the view from one of the largest Ferris wheels in the Southeast. It’s even more impressive at night as it lights up and flashes various colors.

 

3
Bike the Trails

Biking is a popular pastime for everyone visiting our area and is an ideal activity for the whole family. Gulf State Park features more than 28 miles of award-winning paved trails that run throughout both beach towns, offering fantastic views. From the beach to the woods, you’ll explore areas off the beaten path when you ride your bike there. You can rent bikes for free with the park's bike share program or bring your own. Grab the family and hit the trails!

4
Meet Some Wild Friends

Load up the whole gang and head to the Alabama Gulf Coast Zoo, where you can get up close and personal with more than 118 species of animals. Stroll through 25-plus acres of exhibits and learn what the animals eat, where they live, and how they interact. You can even hold and play with a few of the zoo’s residents by opting for an animal encounter. If you’ve ever wanted to pet a sloth or hang out with a lemur, this is the place for you and your family!

5
Explore Historic Fort Morgan

Historic Fort Morgan is the place to bring your crew if you have a history buff in your family or kids who love to explore. This third-system masonry fort was built in 1834 and played an important role in several wars, including the Battle of Mobile Bay during the Civil War. Your family will love checking out the barracks, tunnels, bowyer, and more of the fort’s features. Get ready to travel back in time when you discover this historic spot.

 

6
Paddle Around the Waters

Our gorgeous Gulf waters and beautiful back bays are part of what makes our destination so special. Paddleboarding and kayaking are great ways to experience the waters of the coast. Explore the calm inland waters of the area, such as Lake Shelby in Gulf State Park. Kids will love paddling through the area searching for local wildlife.

7
Get Your Game On

Whether your family is competitive or just loves to play, they’ll have a blast at Fat Daddy’s. This giant arcade has over 80 games, including traditional arcade favorites, claw machines, shooting and racing games, dueling basketball hoops, interactive action games, and lots more. It’s a fantastic spot to cool off during the warmer months or escape the rain.

8
Fly Over the Beach

Soar above the shore for an aerial view of the destination with a helicopter tour. This unique experience offers a once-in-a-lifetime chance to view the Gulf Shores and Orange Beach area from above. Your experienced pilot will point out noteworthy spots in the area during your trip. Choose from Lost Bay Helicopters or Magni Gryoflight and get ready for a memorable ride.

9
Take a Dolphin Cruise

Create family memories that will live forever by taking a dolphin cruise. The guide of your excursion will take you and your family to spots where these friendly creatures hang out. They’ll also tell you all about the behaviors and habits of the dolphins that live on the Gulf Coast. You’ll watch as the dolphins pop out of the water to say hello. Be sure to take your phone or camera so you can snap some pictures!

10
Hit the Mini-Golf Course

Putt-putt is a perfect family activity, and there’s no shortage of mini-golf spots on Alabama’s Beaches! Each of these courses offers a variety of experiences and features like arcades, ice cream shops, and laser tag. Bring the family and play a round or two.

11
Slip & Slide

Get wet and wild at Waterville USA. This family-friendly attraction has been a destination staple for almost 40 years. Waterville boasts a vast waterpark, a mini golf course, go-karts, escape rooms, and an impressive arcade with a Top Golf simulator and bowling lanes. Inside the waterpark, you’ll find thrilling slides, a lazy river, a wave pool, water playgrounds, and a surf simulator, the perfect ways to keep cool during the summer.

12
Go Sailing

You don’t have to own a boat to cruise the Gulf. With a sailing adventure, you can glide across our gorgeous waterways and take in the sights from offshores. These spacious sailboats offer plenty of room to sunbathe and relax in the coastal breeze. While out, you’ll have the opportunity to see marine life like dolphins. Most sailing tours allow you to bring snacks and drinks onboard so you can enjoy a picnic on the water.

13
Find Speed & Thrills

The Track Family Fun Park is a staple for many visitors who come to Alabama’s Beaches because there is fun for all ages! Here you’ll find thrill rides like the Skycoaster and Spinning Coaster as well as family-favorite activities like mini-golf, bumper boats, and an arcade. The Track’s most popular attraction is its multi-level go-kart track, where drivers race up three-and-a-half stories and circle back down again, ending with an exciting drop! Whether you’re looking for hair-raising excitement or classic family fun, you’ll find it at The Track.

Watch Now

Whether you want to take it easy on the water, get lost in nature, or discover thrilling attractions, you’ll find the perfect activities to keep your crew entertained in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach.  

Explore Rentals on Alabama's Beaches

Whatever your vacation style, Alabama’s Beaches have the perfect spot for you. Start planning by choosing your dates and group size, and explore the best vacation rentals in Gulf Shores, comfortable places to stay in Orange Beach, or the charming rentals of Fort Morgan. With verified listings, secure payments, and real support, there are plenty of reasons why you should book with us.

Cheap & Free Things To Do
Cheap & Free Things To Do
in Gulf Shores & Orange Beach
Published on: November 14, 2025
Updated at: May 14, 2026

An unforgettable beach vacation doesn't have to break the bank! Gulf Shores and Orange Beach are home to plenty of fun and affordable things to do that the entire family will enjoy. Check out these activities and attractions, book a place to stay on our lodging page, and start planning your next beach trip!

1
Beach

You came to the Alabama Gulf Coast to visit the beach, and our 32 miles of sugar-white sand beaches are beautiful. One of the best free things to do is to catch the sunrise or sunset over the beach. The colors of the coastal sunsets and sunrises are quite breathtaking.

2
Biking

Biking is an excellent way to explore the area’s natural beauty, and there’s no better place to do that than Gulf State Park. The park offers over 28 miles of paved trails, perfect for hiking and biking. You’ll discover the local wild and plant life as you traverse through the nine different ecosystems inside the park. You can bring your own bike or rent one for free with the park’s bike-share program. Fifty complimentary bikes are located throughout Gulf State Park for guests to use for up to three hours.

3
Orange Beach History Museum

If you’re in Orange Beach, visit the Orange Beach History Museum. Built in 1910, it was originally a schoolhouse before becoming a museum. Inside, you’ll discover memorabilia and artifacts about the local history of Native Americans and the fishing industry. Admission to the museum is free.

4
Gulf Shores Museum

While visiting museums, check out the Gulf Shores Museum, which offers an inside look into the town’s history. It hosts a variety of both permanent and rotating exhibits. Admission is free.

5
Nature Center & Learning Campus

Gulf State Park’s Nature Center and Learning Campus offer amazing free programs that the whole family will enjoy throughout the year. You’ll learn about coastal wildlife, local history and more about the area. The Nature Center is a living museum full of plants and animals native to Gulf Shores and Orange Beach. While there, be sure to take part in one of the guided nature walks, beach walks, or pier walks.

6
Coastal Arts Center

The Coastal Arts Center is your one-stop shop for all things art-related. You’ll have the opportunity to browse the fabulous pieces from local artists on display inside the gallery for free. A glass-blowing and pottery studio are also located on the site, and artists often offer free demonstrations for visitors.

7
Lake Shelby

Believed to be the closest body of freshwater to the Gulf, Lake Shelby provides a gorgeous setting for guests to spend the day. The lake is connect to the Backcountry Trail, so park goers can bike, hike, or drive to this scenic spot. Pack a lunch and enjoy a lakefront picnic at one of the tables scattered around the lake or let the kids play on the playgrounds. Even your four-legged friends will have a blast splashing and playing at the Dog Pond. There are restrooms and parking on-site as well as a pedestrian bridge that leads to The Lodge and Gulf State Park Pier.

8
Bon Secour Wildlife Refuge

Bon Secour National Wildlife Refuge is a a nature lover’s dream. This refuge boasts 7,000 acres of beautiful coastal habitats and is thought to be one of the last remaining undisturbed areas on the Gulf Coast. Inside Bon Secour, you’ll discover four designated hiking trails, a kayak launch, a lookout point, and beach access. You’ll see plenty of native plant life and maybe even a few furry, feathery, and scaly residents who call the refuge home.

9
Bingo & Trivia

Time to add a little friendly competition to your beach vacation. Several restaurants and bars in the area offer free, seasonal bingo and trivia every week. You can also stop by the iconic Flora-Bama Lounge and Oyster Bar any weekday throughout the year for free bingo on the beach. From music bingo to themed trivia, there’s something for everyone to join in on.

10
Barber Marina

You probably didn’t imagine you’d be seeing dinosaurs during your beach trip. However, a quick drive to Barber Marina in Elberta will lead you to prehistoric creatures, a lady in a lake, and Bamahenge, an exact replica of Stonehenge. You’ll find all these and more cool art pieces scattered throughout the grounds of Barber Marina. The marina is free and open to the public.

11
Wisdom Harbour Studios & General Store

Located just above Kilwin’s at The Wharf sits Wisdom Harbour Studio and General Store. This unique spot, owned by best-selling author Andy Andrews, features a free museum, gift shop, and podcast studio. Guests are welcome to drop by and admire his curated collection of sports memorabilia, props from hit TV shows like I Love Lucy and The Andy Griffith Show, and other unique antiques and collectibles. On Tuesdays and Thursdays at 12:15 pm, you can even watch live podcast recordings.

12
Geocaching

While you’re exploring Gulf State Park, pull out your phone and try geocaching. This fun activity will turn your hike along the trails into an exciting scavenger hunt. All you need to do is download the free app and make an account to get started.

13
Claud Peteet Mairculture Center

If you’re looking to combine fun with a little bit of education, visit the Claud Peteet Mariculture Center. Sitting off the beaten path near the Gulf Shores International Airport, this research facility conducts essential research on local sea life and acts as a production for depleted coastal fisheries. On Wednesdays, guests are welcome to tour the center for free by appointment. 

14
Gulf Place Playground

When you need to keep the kiddos entertained, visit Gulf Place Public Beach and let them play to their hearts’ content on the beachfront playground. You can sit on the grassy lawn or relax under the shade while they climb and jump. The sidewalks in this area are also ideal for rollerblading, biking, or skateboarding. Parking at Gulf Place is $15; however, there are nearby free parking lots.

Cheap Things to Do
1
Mini Golf

Mini-golf is the ultimate vacation activity, and here at the beach, we have several themed courses for you to enjoy. The putt-putt spots in the area charge around $5-$12 per person to play, and many offer added amenities like snack bars and arcades.

2
Gulf State Park Pier

Cast your line at the Gulf State Park Fishing and Education Pier. Guests can access the pier for just $9. You can bring your own gear or rent a rod and reel for four hours for $10. If you don’t want to fish, you can visit the pier for only $3 and sightsee.

3
The Wharf

The Wharf in Orange Beach is a great place to spend the afternoon or evening. This 222-acre entertainment and shopping district offers a fun, family-friendly atmosphere and an array of shops, restaurants, and free events throughout the year. While there, check out the area from above with a ride on the Ferris wheel. One of the tallest in the southeast, the Ferris wheel offers riders incredible views for just $8 a person.

4
Historic Fort Morgan

Historic Fort Morgan is a must-see for all guests visiting the area. This iconic masonry fort played an essential role during the Civil War’s Battle of Mobile Bay. Explore the barracks, tunnels, dry moat, beaches and museum found at the site. Admission to Fort Morgan is $8 for adults, $5 for students and children, and free for veterans and active members of the military.

5
The Factory

If you’ve got lots of energy to burn, we’ve got the perfect place for you. The Factory in Gulf Shores boasts a trampoline park, climbing gym, and arcade, ideal for rainy day fun. Bounce away on the 15,000 square feet of trampolines, complete with dodgeball, an obstacle course, and a rope swing. Or put your climbing skills to the test on the adrenaline tower, fun walls, and skyscraper steps. On Wednesdays, it’s only $8 to access the trampoline park or $13 to jump and climb.

6
Movie Theater

Whether you need to cool off or escape the rain, head to the AMC Theater at The Wharf for discounted movies. On Tuesdays and Wednesdays, AMC stub members can score 50% off movie tickets. All you need to do is download the app and sign up!

Find Your Next Adventure on Alabama's Beaches

Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan are where amazing vacations happen! You'll find something special here for everyone in the family. With an endless array of sights, activities and natural beauty, the clear blue waters and white sand of our beaches provide the ideal spot for fun and relaxation. 

View All Things to Do

Watch Visual Stories
Packed with beach vacation tips to help you plan your trip!

Things to Do
Attractions

Gulf Shores and Orange Beach are also largely defined by our many points of interest! Plan a visit to the Alabama Gulf Coast Zoo, Fort Morgan, a local waterpark, or even a Segway tour. For history-lovers, you can also visit a museum or Fort Morgan to experience coastal Alabama's past. 

Natural Beauty

One of the biggest attractions in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach is our boundless nature. From the moment you arrive, the magnificence of the Gulf Coast thrills your senses. Diverse ecosystems line the Alabama coastal region. From freshwater marshes where alligators bask in the sun to coastal hardwood swamps, the region's abundant natural beauty and Gulf State Park may leave you speechless. Experience uninhabited gems like Robinson and Bird Island.

Exhilarating Water Sports
Parasailing

Soar into our blue skies when you go parasailing in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach. Once you glide above the white sand shoreline and gaze in awe at a horizon where turquoise waters dissolve into the blue sky, you may never want to return to earth. Best of all, parasailing requires no special skills or training, making it an ideal family activity.

Dolphin Cruises

Take an intimate look at one nature’s most beautiful animals with one of our many dolphin cruises. Playful one instant, skimming majestically over the surface of the water the next, the native bottlenose dolphins are a marvel. You can even take an Orange Beach or Gulf Shores sailing cruise and experience the world of the dolphins under wind power.

Fishing

The waters off Gulf Shores and Orange Beach provide some of the best fishing in Alabama. For deep-sea fishing, try an Orange Beach fishing charter to hook a giant grouper. If you'd rather relax in the sand, cast a line off the beach in search of flounder, pompano, or sheeps head. Don't forget The Gulf State Park Pier either! With over two thousand feet of rail space to cast a line, plus concessions and shops, it's a prime destination for anglers.

Diving

Crystalline turquoise waters make Gulf Shores and Orange Beach diving a delight for all deep-water enthusiasts. Not a diver yet? You can become one on your vacation! Register for a certification course during your stay so you can dive during your current Gulf Shores trip and then next time you visit as well.

Agendas are for work, the beach is for play. Leave the paperwork behind and embrace a sense of spontaneity with the plethora of attractions and things to do in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach. Dive into the waters and enjoy water sports that will have you sailing and exploring the Gulf Coast. Take advantage of some Gulf Shores and Orange Beach activities on land from zoo’s to waterparks to museums. No matter what you want to do, Gulf Shores and Orange Beach have the activities to make your trip special.

Fishing
Alabama's Best Fishing

Alabama's Beaches is a fishing heaven. Our waterways are home to an abundance of prized species and plenty of fishing experiences, such as inshore and offshore charters, piers, 32 miles of beaches to cast off on, and one of the largest artificial reef systems in the world. No matter what you're hoping to catch, you'll have a blast fishing in our coastal waters.

View All Fishing Charters & Tours

What's Biting
Now

You can hook anything at anytime on Alabama's Beaches. Spring brings various species like pompano, Spanish mackerel, and black drum near our shores, while summer is the ultimate season for an offshore trip to target red snapper, mahi, and grouper. Cast off for Jack Crevalle and flounder in fall, then brave the chill and head to the surf for redfish and whiting in winter.

Fishing Seasons

Get Ready to Fish

If you plan to bring your own vessel, learn about the area's marinas and boat launches. No boat? No problem! You’ll find several boat rental companies in Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan. After you return from a day on the water, take your haul to one of Cook Your Catch restaurants, where you can have your fish prepared just how you like! Plan the perfect fishing trip from start to finish with these local businesses.

RED SNAPPER SEASON

Known as the “Red Snapper Capital of the World,” Gulf Shores and Orange Beach are the best places to find these remarkable and delicious fish. The 2026 federal red snapper season for for-hire vessels opens on 12:01 am on June 1 and will close on 12:01 am on October 26. 

The 2026 state licensed vessels and private red snapper season in Alabama opens on Friday, May 22 and will be open 7 days a week until the end of the year or until the state's quota has been met.

Fishing
License

If you plan to fish, whether by boat, pier, or on the shores, when in Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, and Fort Morgan, you will need a saltwater fishing license. You can easily purchase a license online from Outdoor Alabama. Those fishing on a charter boat trip do not need a license, as the boat’s license covers passengers.

Fishing Charters & Tours

With one of the largest charter fleets on the Gulf, there is no better place to fish than Alabama’s Beaches. Choose from inshore, offshore, and deep-sea trips, as well as half-day, full-day, and overnight experiences. When you book a charter excursion, your bait, tackle and fishing license are provided as part of the package. Your knowledgeable captain and deckhands will get you to the fish and show you how to hook your trophy.

Boat Launches - Choose a launch along the bay, on the coast or in one of the local bayous or waterways. From deep hull to personal watercraft, the Orange Beach and Gulf Shores offer numerous boat launches and ramps to accommodate your watercraft type and lodging location.
 
Marinas - For those who prefer a full-service boating destination, a wide selection of marinas offer all of the amenities boaters require, including docking, fuel, service, equipment, and dining.
 
Boat Repairs and Service - A complete array of boating repair and maintenance services is available to keep you afloat and motoring.
 
Boat Rentals - From fishing to fun partying to just plain relaxing afloat, our reputable boat rental services will provide you with the perfect watercraft for your needs. Our rental services can help you with anything from Orange Beach fishing charters to pontoon boats.
FISHING AND BOATING ON ALABAMA’S GULF COAST

It’s no surprise that many bring their boats to Gulf Shores and Orange Beach for one purpose: to fish. Nominated as one of the World Fishing Networks' Ultimate Fishing Towns in America, Orange Beach (and its companion Gulf Shores) attract anglers from around the country. That’s because the fish are plentiful and we make a fishing excursion on the Gulf easy.

Bring your boat, rent a boat or charter a fishing excursion. It’s your choice. Then, spend the day with friends or family cruising the coastline for red drum, tuna or flounder. Motor out to deep water in search of giant grouper or fish the bayous and backwaters for blacktail. Whatever your fishing preference, our friendly people will give you pointers and let you in on the best spots to hook your favorite fish. They'll also be happy to let you know the best way to get there by boat. After all, fishing and boating go together. Be sure to sign up for Coastal Catch to stay up-to-date on all things fishing on Alabama's Beaches. 

Boat Where You Stay

Worried about where to park your boat after a day on the water? Don’t be. The plentiful boat parking and overnight facilities in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach make it easy to secure your boat. If you prefer, take advantage of the available boat-friendly lodging and keep your boat close at hand, with easy access at all hours.

Southern hospitality, full boating amenities, Gulf breezes, turquoise waters and sugar-white sand beaches all add up to the singular boating experience in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach. Be sure to visit bootable islands like Robinson and Bird Islands. Visit us today and plan your visit to our boater’s paradise. Don't forget to check out our beach vacation packages as well as our Gulf Shores and Orange Beach rentals, including beach condos, hotels, and house rentals!

Jet Skiing on Alabama's Beaches

If you're looking for thrills and adventure on your vacation, make Jet Skiing off Gulf Shores and Orange Beach one of your first choices. Nothing beats a day on the Gulf  with the wind on your face and the sea splash all around you. You can gently glide away from all your worries or get your adrenaline fix with a fast-paced romp through the waves when you rent a Jet Ski or WaveRunner.

Where to Jet Ski

With a variety of Jet Ski and WaveRunner vendors located throughout Alabama's Beaches, you have endless offers for your water fun and entertainment. You can have your watercraft rental for as short as one hour or up to 8 hours, allowing you to explore all the beautiful turquoise waters of Orange Beach, Gulf Shores and Fort Morgan.

The Intracoastal Waterway has many wonderful experiences in store for a Jet Ski rider in Gulf Shores & Orange Beach. Gulf Shores' section of the Alabama Intracoastal Waterway spans from Perdido and Dauphin Island. While on your Jet Ski adventure, feel free to maneuver your watercraft safely around these islands while you explore their natural beauty, wildlife and history. There truly is nothing more magnificent than exploring these natural jewels that exist in the sparkling waters of the Gulf and Orange Beach.

If you want to experience the marine wildlife from your Jet Ski or WaveRunner, the Intracoastal Waterway holds some of nature's most beautiful creatures in their natural environment. You will marvel at the graceful beauty of the stingrays and enjoy the frolicking play of the bottlenose dolphin. Make sure to stop by Robinson and Bird Islands in Orange Beach. There is no better way to experience these beautiful creatures than on your own personal Jet Ski adventure.

Jet Ski in a Group or By Yourself

Want to whip through the waves by yourself and get an adrenaline rush? Or do you want to take a memorable meander along the Intercoastal Waterway with your children or grandchildren aboard? With a Gulf Shores or Orange Beach Jet Ski rental, you can choose to ride on a solo adventure or put as many as three family members on the same Jet Ski. With so many options to choose from, a Gulf Shores Jet Ski rental will surely give you the time of your life that everyone will remember forever.
